name: Bay command-termination feedback
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Reports the defined end state of the assigned control transaction.
description: Reports the defined end state of the assigned control transaction. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Command execution result” at the input and “Control transaction completion” at the output. A completed transaction may still require physical feedback.
